title: Former DIG head tells Congress CIA spied on whistleblowers
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Former DIG head tells Congress CIA spied on whistleblowers, about 2026 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They found out the CIA was spying on the whistleblowers.

plain: A filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026, relays what a man he calls John, a former head of a government investigative group, told Congress. Corbell says the finding was that the CIA had been spying on UFO whistleblowers, people who came forward with inside claims. He mentions figures including intelligence chief Tulsi Gabbard, former Pentagon official Lou Elizondo, and journalist George Knapp. If true, it would mean the spy agency was watching the very people trying to talk.
